skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 450% ATK as Direct DMG to all enemies in a row with a 5-hit combo. During the first 5 rounds, has an 80% chance to inflict [Intimidation] on 2 random enemies for 1 round. [Intimidation]: Prevents the affected unit from acting and reduces all DMG Immunity by 30%. This effect is treated as a [Stun] state.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 600% ATK as Direct DMG to all enemies in a row with a 5-hit combo. During the first 5 rounds, has a 100% chance to inflict [Intimidation] on 3 random enemies for 1 round. [Intimidation]: Prevents the affected unit from acting and reduces all DMG Immunity by 40%. This effect is treated as a [Stun] state.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Specialized Dodge]. After any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 1 ally. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Specialized Dodge]. After any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 2 allies. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Specialized Dodge]. After any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 3 allies. [Specialized Dodge]: Direct DMG, Continuous DMG, Injury DMG, and Extra DMG only deal 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Ignores the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Panic]. Increases the [Hit] stat of all allies by 30%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Ignores the additional consumption effect caused by [Specialized Panic]. Increases the [Hit] stat of all allies by 40%. At battle start, has a 100% chance to inflict [Intimidation] on 3 random enemies for 1 round.

effects.desc: [Faint's] powerful and final stun, which can only be removed with specialized debuffs.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
